_about: Everything the site states that BrandTokens (thallo/brand/tokens.py) has no slot for, plus provenance for each brand.json value. Not read by load_brand. Values are copied from the site, never rescaled or invented. Where the site gives oklch only, the oklch string is kept and no hex is derived here.
checked_against_live: 2026-11-16: css/brand-overlay.css, css/brand-identity-system.css, favicon.svg and llms.txt are byte-identical to the live files. The HTML pages differ only where Cloudflare rewrites the email address.

provenance.colors.ink: #0E1116: favicon.svg (stop-color). The brand book and overlay CSS define ink as oklch(0.16 0.012 260), no hex.
provenance.colors.paper: #F4F3EF: css/brand-overlay.css :root --paper and site.webmanifest background_color. brand-identity-system.css says oklch(0.975 0.004 260); favicon.svg uses #F4F5F7.
provenance.colors.accent: #1F40C7: meta theme-color on brand-identity.html, site.webmanifest theme_color, favicon.svg stop-color. The brand book defines accent as oklch(0.42 0.21 265), no hex.
provenance.colors.on_accent: Brand book, contrast table: 'paper on ultramarine 8.4 : 1'. So paper, same hex as colors.paper.
provenance.colors.scrim: rgba(16, 18, 28, 0.92): the end stop of the live .work-card-overlay gradient in css/brand-overlay.css. It is a site implementation, not a brand-book rule. The brand book says 'No text overlays.' with an exception for social captions on full-bleed visuals.
provenance.colors.on_scrim: css/brand-overlay.css: .work-card-title color var(--paper). Same hex as colors.paper.
provenance.type_scale: brand-identity.html section 04 (web px): display 64, h1 48, h2 36, body 18, small 14. h3 28 and mono label 12 are in extras below. These are web px, not px on a 1080 px canvas.
provenance.spacing: brand-identity.html section 05 grid line: '12 columns, 24 px gutter, max 1240 px, outer 48 px'. margin = outer 48, gap = gutter 24. The site does not call them margin and gap.
provenance.radii: brand-identity-system.css --r-1 2, --r-2 4, --r-3 8, --r-4 12, --r-full 999. brand-overlay.css overrides r-4 to 14 and adds r-5 22 (brand-identity-system.css has r-5 20).
provenance.logo.file: favicon.svg as published at https://saikanagat.com/favicon.svg (64 x 64 viewBox, so aspect 1).
provenance.script/latin.json: Bricolage Grotesque for display and body per brand-identity.html section 04. Display weight 700 and body 400 are the brand book specimen values; the live overlay CSS sets headings to 500.

palette_oklch._note: Verbatim from css/brand-identity-system.css and brand-identity.html. Not converted.

neutral_scale.n-300: oklch(0.85 0.008 260) in brand-identity-system.css, oklch(0.86 0.008 260) in brand-overlay.css

usage_rules_quoted: Anchor in ink. Breathe in paper.
If it appears more than once per visible region, the layout is wrong.
System colors (positive / negative / warning) are reserved for function

serif.role: italic accents only, one per surface

css_stacks.mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace

type.delivery: Google Fonts @import (no font files in the site repo).

scale_px_web.body: 18px, 400, 1.55 (1.4 for short marketing lines, 1.7 for long-form)

rules_quoted: Headlines, navigation, and mono labels are uppercase. Body, lede, and captions are sentence-case.
Avoid going smaller than 14 px on screen.

radii_defaults_quoted: Defaults: r-3 for cards & inputs · r-4 for surfaces & modals · r-full for buttons & pills · r-0 for tables, print, ads

shadows.brand_overlay_css_differs: Same five steps, tinted rgba(20,14,8,...) instead of rgba(8,12,28,...).

icons.color: single colour only: ink, accent, or paper

logo.wordmark: Set in HTML text, not a file: the mark, then SAI KANAGAT in Bricolage Grotesque 700 uppercase, tracking -0.04em (brand-identity-system.css .wm-hero). The nav on the live pages shows the text 'SK.' with an accent period.
logo.clear_space_quoted: minimum padding = x · height of the mark
logo.note: The published favicon.svg draws the split with a hard-stop linear gradient. The brand book says 'no gradients' about the logo.

modes_quoted: Object & material for the design side
Editorial portrait for the marketing side
rules_quoted: natural light, deep shadows, no overlays
single subject, off-center, room to crop for stories
Color comes from the subject, never the filter.
A single soft source from window-left.
Fill the frame with one subject, or give it five times the room.
stock photography that isn't yours · auto-generated AI imagery · gradients on brand surfaces
photo_treatment.brand_image_files_on_site: assets/images/BRAND/01-cover.jpg to 07-fitall.jpg (brand book page images, JPEG). Not copied: they are page screenshots, not photography to reuse.

components_quoted.cta: One per page, max. The big confident gesture.
components_quoted.cta_format: 2–3 words, action verb, ALL CAPS in mono.
